heading: 3D model library
overLimit: Over your {plan} plan limit of {limit} models.
chooseFromFilesLabel: Open file picker to choose a 3D model from Shopify Files
deleteBody_one: This removes the model from your library. The .glb file itself stays in Shopify Files, and any page still embedding the model will stop rendering it.
deleteBody_other: This removes {count} models from your library. The .glb files themselves stay in Shopify Files, and any page still embedding them will stop rendering them.
intro: Manage standalone 3D models you embed with the “3D Viewer — Any Model” theme block.
dropLabel: Drop .glb or .gltf files here, or click to choose
addHint: Add several at once. Each stored file can be up to {max} MB.
addHintOptimize: With optimization on you can upload up to {max} MB; the size is checked after compression.
optimizeDetails: Compresses the geometry and shrinks oversized textures before upload — usually 50–90% smaller, so models load faster for shoppers. Turn off to upload the file exactly as it is.
stagedErrors_one: {count} file can't be added. Remove it to continue.
stagedErrors_other: {count} files can't be added. Remove them to continue.
mustOptimize: {size} · must optimize to {max} MB or less
uploadsContinue: You can reload or leave this page — uploads continue in the background and pick up where they left off. If you close the app, they resume the next time you open this page.
optimizingAndSaving: Optimizing and saving to Shopify Files…
emptyTitle: No models in your library yet.
emptyHint: Drop .glb files above or import an existing one.
